title: Starward
tagline: A roguelite deckbuilder across three hostile sectors.
description:
Carry the beacon core from the edge of the Ember Verge to the Eclipse. Chart a path across each sector map — battles, elites, strange signals, black-market traders and repair docks — and build a deck from more than thirty cards while outfitting your ship with sixteen modules.

Every fight is a puzzle of energy, shields and enemy intents. Three bosses stand in your way, and five Threat levels await anyone who makes it through.
controls: Click a card to play it (then click a target if needed). Keyboard: 1–0 pick a card, ←/→ choose a target, Enter confirm, E end turn, Esc cancel.

achievements.title: Beyond the Eclipse
achievements.description: Deliver the beacon — win a run.

achievements.title: Hardened
achievements.description: Win a run at Threat 3 or higher.

achievements.title: Overkill
achievements.description: Deal 40 damage with a single card.

achievements.title: Untouchable
achievements.description: Defeat a boss without losing any hull.

achievements.title: Travel Light
achievements.description: Win a run with 15 or fewer cards.
